entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I just can't forgive Madarame, but...[n]what Ann said made me think...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: To Yusuke, are we just a buncha thugs?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It ain't like he thinks it is! Pisses me off[n]just thinkin' about it!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Good people have to put up with[n]so much crap while... while shitty[n]adults do whatever they want!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Makes me sick, I-I'm not wrong, am I?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Sorry, man... I feel like I've been[n]botherin' you with too many[n]questions...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Don't tell Ann I called you, by the way.[n]Seriously.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Bein' framed, and the added bounty...[n]It all felt like such bullshit.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It is confusing. We're wanted criminals[n]now...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Maybe I haven't changed at all[n]since that time we went up[n]against Kamoshida...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I wanted to be a phantom thief because[n]I thought even someone like me could[n]be a hero...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It made me so happy to be depended on.[n]Guess it all went straight to my head.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I thought I could do anythin' if it was[n]for justice. But that'd make me[n]no different from our targets...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I called them shitbags, but I must be[n]the shittiest of shitbags. I can't even[n]joke about it...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I can start by changin' who I am now.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Thanks, [fName]. I feel like I can[n]think straight now.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh—I scared Haru and Futaba, didn't I...?[n]I'll have to apologize to them soon.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's me. Sorry, I know you're tired.[n]It'll be a sec, just hear me out.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I've decided what I want to do with[n]Shido after goin' into his Palace.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We can't let him run free. If there's[n]a heart we gotta steal, it's definitely[n]gotta be his.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah. Man, you knew this whole time,[n]huh?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I want to avenge you, that's a no-brainer,[n]but that's not it.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: If we let him run the country, the weak[n]will be totally effed.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Isn't it our duty to protect them?
We'll protect them till the end.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Remember when I told you that heroes[n]who lurk in the shadows are boring?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Well, forget what I said. Those heroes[n]are way cooler.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Let's do it. Let's steal that bastard[n]Shido's heart. I'll do everythin' I can[n]to make it happen.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Thanks for listenin' to me, [fName].[n]See ya.
